name: add-platform
title: Add Platform
description: Add a target platform to an existing project while preserving its existing platform configuration and progress.
preservation: Preserve every selection, validation, and manifest gate
selection: An initialized project needs another platform.
outputs: Adds one platform and its setup gates.

name: assimilate
title: Assimilate
description: Analyze new mockups or inspiration and propose additions to the design system. Use evolve to reconcile refreshed designs with built components.
preservation: Run the complete shared design analysis and gate, write the report, and persist only what the user confirms
selection: New inspiration or mockups need design analysis.
inputs: HTML/image exports, extracted bundles, URLs, or inspiration.
outputs: Writes an analysis report; persists confirmed additions.

name: build
title: Build
description: Implement or resume the confirmed component and screen plan. Use evolve when updated designs require reassessing completed work.
preservation: Do not summarize, replace, or stub any implementation, test, sandbox, or gate
selection: A confirmed plan has unfinished implementation.
inputs: Scaffolded project, confirmed inventory, and optional platform.
outputs: Writes components, screens, stories, and verification records.

name: evolve
title: Evolve
description: Reconcile an existing UI system with updated designs or requirements, plan visual and inventory changes, and coordinate implementation and verification.
preservation: Confirm the full delta before any write or delete; hand additions to build; prove with re-capture; never silent-duplicate or silent-sweep
selection: Updated exports or requirements require broad reassessment of built work.
inputs: Existing project; --refresh <source...> [--platform <name>] [--reanalyze], --resume <run-id>, or an inventory delta.
outputs: Stages revisions and one change plan; accepted edits create resumable progress and evidence.

name: init
title: Init
description: Initialize a new UI project and record its goals, platforms, and toolchain. For an existing project, inspect status and resume its workflow.
preservation: Preserve every discovery, selection, validation, and manifest gate
selection: Starting a project without a confirmed setup.
inputs: Project goals and directory; existing manifests are inspected first.
outputs: Records confirmed project and platform setup.

name: refine
title: Refine
description: Apply a specific correction to named components, screens, or theme using feedback or a reference. Use evolve for broad reassessment or inventory changes.
preservation: Do not substitute mockups or placeholders for requested product changes
selection: A known target needs a specific correction.
inputs: Scaffolded project and named component, screen, theme, feedback, or reference.
outputs: Edits the target and reruns affected verification.

name: research
title: Research
description: Research UI patterns, products, or libraries and save findings for later design decisions.
preservation: Use current sources and preserve every required evidence field and output
selection: Evidence is needed before choosing a design or library.
inputs: Topic, product, URL, or library question.

name: scaffold
title: Scaffold
description: Set up the selected framework, tokens, component sandbox, and capture tooling before building product components.
preservation: Preserve every installation, render, and verification gate
selection: Tool selections are confirmed and the platform needs setup.
outputs: Installs tools and writes theme, sandbox, and capture setup.

name: status
title: Status
description: Inspect current progress, reference freshness, unfinished refresh work, and the next appropriate command without changing project configuration.
preservation: Report actual state without inventing progress
selection: Returning to a project or deciding the next command.
inputs: Project directory and existing manifest, if present.
outputs: Reports shape, capture readiness, historical passes, and pending work; never migrates.

name: verify
title: Verify
description: Check implementation, reference fidelity, and affected behavior; record evidence and incomplete work. Apply repairs only when requested with --fix.
preservation: Never fake evidence, weaken a gate, or report a partial check as complete
selection: Current evidence or outstanding work needs checking.
outputs: Reports current checks and incomplete work; --fix authorizes repairs.

name: wireframe
title: Wireframe
description: Create low-fidelity layouts and state maps from requirements or concepts before implementation.
preservation: Produce the complete required wireframe set, states, annotations, and mappings
selection: Requirements need a structural design before building.
outputs: Writes layouts, state maps, and design mappings.
